notes: v2.9.37 - Two fixes. History bodies: athena stopped exposing the exact expand-control class the reader clicked, which failed every encounter body instantly; the reader now recognizes several same-row expand-control shapes, retries that failure with the existing bounded reopen, and records a redacted diagnostic when a row still will not open. Console noise: the extension no longer creates its timing worker on unrelated sites (Gmail and other strict pages logged security-policy errors on every load); it is created only when needed on MLS and athena pages.
